test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

After a day long trek, we were so tired that we were ready to _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'hit the sack'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"hit the sack"** means to go to bed or to go to sleep. (सोने जाना)

 
 
• **Example: **After finishing all my work, I decided to hit the sack early.
 
 
 
• **"Face the music" **means to confront the consequences of one's actions. (परिणामों का सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **After failing the exam, he had to face the music from his parents.
 
 
 
• **"Get into deep water" **refers to getting into trouble or a difficult situation. (मुश्किल में पड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **She got into deep water when she couldn't repay her loan on time.
 
 
 
• **"Go from rags to riches" **means to rise from poverty to wealth. (गरीबी से अमीरी तक पहुंचना)
 
 
• **Example: **His inspiring story of going from rags to riches is well-known in the business world.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'hit the sack'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Face the music **(परिणामों का सामना करना): Confront the consequences of one's actions.

 
 
• **Example:** After failing the exam, he had to face the music from his parents.
 
 
 
• **Get into deep water **(मुश्किल में पड़ना): Getting into trouble or a difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example: **She got into deep water when she couldn't repay her loan on time.
 
 
 
• **Go from rags to riches** (गरीबी से अमीरी तक पहुंचना): To rise from poverty to wealth.
 
 
• **Example:** His inspiring story of going from rags to riches is well-known in the business world.

The correct answer is **Option 2**.
